messages.subject: same summary statistic but fail to get the same result
parts:
Dear all,
 
Thanks for making such amazing package. I tried to use the same summary statistics and same code you posted on github, and when i run the Genetic multiple regression (similar to GWIS),  unfortunately i couldn't get the same result.  :(
Here is my R script（genetic_multiple_regression.R), the script not only present my code but also present my result. I am wondering if it's the educational achievement (Rietveld et al., 2013) summary statistics has changed, so i cannot get the same result.


Another thing that confuses me is i want to use the Genetic multiple regression (similar to GWIS) to specify a multiple regression model in which MDD,PTSD and ANX all predict intelligence. So i changed the code as you can see in another R script (intelligence_MDD_PTSD_ANX.R), and i got a warning "The standardized model failed to converge." I am curious why this warning appears.

I will be appericiate if you could help me to figure it all, but thank you anyway, thank you again for this amzing package!

Best,
Liling

messages.author: d6d83e22ef3ba9f1
messages.subject: Re: same summary statistic but fail to get the same result
parts:
Hi Liling, 

I'm not sure why you are getting different results from the GWIS; I just reran using the summary statistics I have and am getting the same result as on the github so I don't the huge differences you are seeing are related to any recent code updates. If you post the .log files from munge and the genetic covariance matrix (GWIS$S) I'm assuming there is some difference in the summary stats  we are using and that could help figure out which one is off. On that point, I know the PGC updated their summary stats download page recently and I'm actually having a hard time finding those old BIP and SCZ summary stats; did you already have them or did you recently download them to follow the example on the wiki? 

Best, 
  Andrew
